theater: 淮南西部壽州柘皋戰線

battle.name: 柘皋之戰
battle.theater: 淮南西部壽州柘皋戰線
battle.brief: 紹興十一年十一月，金人南侵受阻於順昌，完顏宗弼退屯淮南壽州柘皋。張俊自泗州率中軍北上，與劉錡會師，先以強弩齊射覆蓋金軍前陣，再擲火藥炸彈破其行列，步騎一路追至淮水。卡面的十字弩正是宋軍守城與野戰破陣的骨幹，射速雖慢，單矢破甲之力可恃。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 柘皋之戰是紹興十一年十一月南宋與金朝在淮南西部的一場會戰，交戰的兩邊恰恰是兩個正在議和的政權。南宋方面以右丞相、淮東招討使張俊為總督，統轄自泗州北上的一支大軍，並與駐守順昌的淮西制置使劉錡所部、留守淮南各處的淮西軍、淮東軍、京湖軍一部及沿路勤王部隊會合，總兵力記為十餘萬；行在方面由高宗趙構坐鎮臨安，樞密院與弓弩院掌軍械糧秣的調度。金朝方面由金熙宗完顏亶下令，統軍大將完顏宗弼率河南、關中兩路兵馬沿淮北上，主力直指淮南重鎮順昌；其軍隊由女真、契丹、渤海諸部族兵與收編的漢軍混編而成，分正軍與漢軍兩套編制，騎兵比例高，後勤倚賴河北、山東的糧道與新開的漕運。金人兵鋒直指江淮，是要逼南宋放棄《紹興和議》所得的河南之地；宋廷則把此役視為能否守住淮南防線、換得和議條件的最後一場硬仗。
countriesEn: The Battle of Zhegao was a November 1141 (the eleventh year of the Shaoxing era) engagement in the western Huai River region between the Southern Song and the Jin dynasty, two states that were at that very moment negotiating a peace settlement. On the Song side the overall command belonged to Zhang Jun, Right Chancellor and Pacification Commissioner for the eastern Huai, who led the column that marched north from Si Zhou; he was joined by the troops of Liu Qi, Pacification Commissioner for the western Huai and defender of Shun Chang, by the western Huai and eastern Huai armies, by part of the Jinghu army, and by auxiliary columns drawn from the districts along the route, a total recorded as more than one hundred thousand men. At the capital the emperor Zhao Gou remained at Lin'an, while the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Workshop of Bows and Crossbows handled the flow of weapons and provisions. On the Jin side the order came from the Jin emperor Wanyan Dan, and the commander in chief was Wanyan Zongbi, who led the columns out of Henan and Guanzhong north of the Huai, driving his main effort at the important Song stronghold of Shun Chang. His army mixed Jurchen, Khitan and Bohai tribal troops with incorporated Han troops, divided into regular and Han formations, carried a high proportion of cavalry, and still leaned for logistics on the grain roads of Hebei and Shandong and on newly opened transport waterways. The Jin thrust into Jiang-Huai was meant to force the Song to surrender the lands of Henan it had gained under the Shaoxing peace settlement, and the Song court treated the campaign as the last hard fight in which the Huai River line might be held and the terms of the peace confirmed.
people: 此役前後決策的人分屬兩邊。金軍主帥完顏宗弼是金太宗完顏晟之子、海陵王的同母兄弟，自金熙宗即位後手握重兵，是金廷最堅決的南進之輩。他奉命取河南，圍順昌受阻，怒而斬部將以肅軍紀，退屯柘皋之後又在宋軍追擊下大敗，最後只與數十騎突出重圍北渡，翌年即病歿，南侵之志未成而名望重挫。南宋一方的主角是淮西制置使劉錡，他以少量精兵守順昌，用強弩與霹靂砲打退金人的攻城器械，麾下被稱為八字軍的將士是他的底子，淮西軍的戰法在前一次交鋒中已成形。張俊領軍北上後，在柘皋主持追擊的決策，成敗幾乎全繫於他是否乘勝窮追；金軍新集之眾尚未整頓便再受創，張俊也得以保全實力與和議的籌碼，返朝後轉為主和。行在方面，樞密使秦檜與主持和議的湯思退力主忍辱議和，高宗趙構既要保留中原故土，又不敢再開釁端，戰與和的取捨，押在淮南這幾場戰役的結果上。除此之外，淮南各處隨軍的軍官與匠人同樣在關鍵處：製弩、配矢、築壘、備火藥、籌船運糧，這些技術環節直接決定了城頭與陣前的勝負。
peopleEn: The people who made the decisions on both sides fall into two groups. On the Jin side the commander in chief, Wanyan Zongbi, was a son of Jin Taizong Wanyan Sheng and the full brother of the Prince of Hailing; once Wanyan Dan had taken the throne he held the heaviest command in the empire and was the most committed advocate of a southern advance. Ordered to recover Henan, he was checked at Shun Chang, cut down his own officers to stiffen the ranks after the failure, retired to Zhegao after the siege was broken, and was then beaten again when the Song pursued him; he escaped with only a few tens of horsemen and crossed back to the north, dying of illness the following year with his southern campaign unfinished and his reputation badly dented. On the Song side the central figure was Liu Qi, Pacification Commissioner for the western Huai. He held Shun Chang with a small body of picked troops, breaking the Jin assault equipment with powerful crossbows and thunder-crash bombs, and the soldiers known as the Eight-Character Army were the foundation of his strength; the tactical habits of the western Huai army had already been forged in that earlier engagement. Once Zhang Jun led his troops north he took the decision to press the pursuit at Zhegao, and the outcome turned almost entirely on whether he would follow the enemy up. The Jin had not yet finished reorganising their newly brought-up troops when they were struck again, and Zhang Jun likewise preserved his own force and his bargaining position for the peace talks, returning to court as a partisan of settlement. At the capital the Privy Councillor Qin Hui and the envoy who actually signed the settlement, Tang Si-tui, pressed hard for a humiliating peace; the emperor Zhao Gou wanted to keep the old Central Plains lands yet dared not light a new war, so the choice between fighting and negotiating was left to the outcome of the fighting in the Huai valley. Alongside them the regimental officers and artisans of the Song columns mattered just as much: making crossbows, matching bolts to them, building redoubts, preparing the bomb charges, and moving grain by boat were all technical tasks that decided the outcome on the walls and in the field.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩，就是此役宋軍在城頭與陣前最見成效的冷兵器。弩以弩臂、弦、機括、弩身為主，張弦靠足踏、槓壓或絞盤，發矢只須扣機，單支弩矢破甲之力遠勝步弓，代價是裝填繁慢，一兵一弩在野戰中難以壓住對面連射。宋代設有專掌造弩的弓弩院，制式強弩有神臂弓、硬弓、蹶張弩，以及架在木床上的床子弩，大型神臂弓需二三人合力張弦，射程可及二百四十步上下，居高臨下足以壓住仰攻的雲梯；劉錡在順昌所倚重的破敵弓與各式強弩即屬此類。柘皋決戰時，宋軍先以弩箭齊射覆蓋金軍前陣，再以步弓補射空檔。與弩並用的是長槍、長刀與大盾，用來護住弩手不被貼身近戰。金人攻順昌備有雲梯、撞竿一類器械，宋軍則以矢石、火箭及從城上擲下的霹靂砲回敬；霹靂砲是裝了火藥的陶罐，擲出即炸，是現存記載中最早的火藥爆彈使用之一。此外還有投石機、攻守兩用的鼓風與運糧車船；弩手的箭按日計耗，一場城頭齊射的存量往往只夠支撐數日，淮河舟船才是糧秣的骨幹。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card is the cold weapon that served the Song army best of all on the walls and in the field in this campaign. A crossbow consists of its bow-arms, the string, the lock mechanism and the stock; the string is drawn by foot pressure, by lever or by windlass, and the shot is loosed by squeezing the trigger, so that a single bolt pierces armour far better than a bow-arrow, at the price of slow loading, and a single crossbowman cannot in open ground hold down the enemy's rapid fire. The Song maintained a dedicated Workshop of Bows and Crossbows for the manufacture of such weapons. The standard strong crossbows included the divine-arm bow, the hard bow, the foot-drawn crossbow and the bed crossbow mounted on a wooden frame; the large divine-arm bow took two or three men to draw and reached a range of something like 240 paces, and from a wall it was enough to pin down the assault ladders. The powerful crossbows and the so-called enemy-breaking bows on which Liu Qi relied at Shun Chang belonged to this family. At the battle of Zhegao the Song lines first covered the Jin front with a volley of crossbow bolts and then filled the gaps with foot bowmen. Alongside the crossbows were long spears, long sabres and large shields, used to shield the crossbowmen from hand-to-hand assault. The Jin brought ladders and battering rams against Shun Chang, and the Song answered with stones, fire-arrows and thunder-crash bombs dropped from the wall: the thunder-crash bomb was a clay jar loaded with gunpowder that detonated on impact, one of the earliest recorded uses of gunpowder bombs. There were also stone-throwing engines, sieges and transport carts and boats; the arrows of the crossbowmen were counted out by the day, so a few volleys from the walls exhausted a month's supply, and the boats on the Huai remained the backbone of the army's food and transport.
tactics: 順昌與柘皋是兩種完全不同的打法。順昌是守城，劉錡把城牆變成弩位：神臂弓與強弩分層配置，居高射擊金軍攻城的雲梯與盾車；對方搭梯接近牆頭即以矢石砸、以火箭燒，屢攻不下，金軍攻城月餘而糧道與士氣先垮，宋軍趁夜出城焚其營寨，迫金軍退屯柘皋。柘皋是野戰，張俊以中軍為正面，劉錡引淮西軍為主攻，兩翼置騎兵候之；劉錡的八字軍以兩行前拒、中央長槍、兩翼弓弩的雁翼式配置展開，專吃對手正面。開戰時宋軍不急於騎戰，先用弩箭齊射覆蓋金軍前陣，再以火藥炸彈擲入金軍密集的隊形，炸響與火光同時令其行列大亂；緊接著步卒踏前、弓弩齊放、騎兵自兩翼突出，白晝的光線使金軍騎兵無法用騎射抵擋。金軍前軍一破便全線崩潰，完顏宗弼突圍北走，宋軍騎兵追到淮水，金軍遂焚柘皋營寨北撤。補給線上，宋軍自泗州沿淮北岸行軍，糧秣多由淮河船運，並以游騎切斷金軍在淮北的糧道；金軍戰力大半靠河北運來的糧草支撐，後路一斷便撐不住整場攻勢。
tacticsEn: Shun Chang and Zhegao were two entirely different kinds of fighting. Shun Chang was a defence of a fortified town, and Liu Qi turned the wall into a battery of crossbows: divine-arm bows and strong crossbows were posted in tiers, shooting down from above at the assault ladders and shielded carts of the Jin. When the enemy ladders neared the parapet they were crushed with stones and burnt with fire-arrows, and repeated assaults came to nothing; after more than a month of siege the Jin supply lines and morale gave out first, and the Song sallied out by night to burn their camp, forcing the Jin back to Zhegao. Zhegao was a battle in the open. Zhang Jun put the central army in front, Liu Qi led the western Huai troops as the main effort, and cavalry was held on both wings; Liu Qi's Eight-Character Army was deployed in a goose-wing shape of two lines of refusal in front, long spears in the centre and bows and crossbows on the flanks, an arrangement built to break the enemy's front. The Song did not rush into a cavalry fight at the start: they first covered the Jin front with a volley of crossbow bolts, then hurled gunpowder bombs into the dense formations so that the detonations and the flames disordered the ranks at the same moment. Immediately afterwards the foot advanced, bows and crossbows loosed as one, and the cavalry struck out from both flanks; in daylight the Jin horsemen could not answer with their own bow work. Once the Jin front broke, the whole line collapsed. Wanyan Zongbi broke out towards the north, the Song cavalry pursued to the Huai, and the Jin burned their camp at Zhegao and withdrew north. On the line of supply the Song marched from Si Zhou along the north bank of the Huai, moving their grain chiefly by boat, and used raiding parties to cut the Jin supply road north of the river; the Jin war effort rested largely on grain sent down from Hebei, and once the rear was cut the whole offensive could no longer be sustained.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，以下只列諸史記載較穩妥者。順昌守軍：據《宋史·劉錡傳》，劉錡部精兵約一萬八千餘人，另有城內民兵若干，配強弩與霹靂砲。金軍南侵兵力：分數路南下，總數記為十餘萬；順昌城下與柘皋一線的金軍主力多稱十萬之眾，但各書記載不一，諸說並存。宋軍追擊兵力：張俊自泗州率軍北上，會劉錡及淮南各軍，總計亦記為十餘萬。圍城時間：順昌被圍約一個多月，其間金軍屢攻不下。弩的射程與射速：據《宋史·兵志》，神臂弓有效射程約二百四十步上下，而大型弩需二三人合力張弦，裝填費時，故一次齊射之後即須退回掩體重裝，弩的爆發力因此只能以「射一停一」的節奏使用。傷亡與斬獲：柘皋之戰宋軍斬獲甚眾，但首級與俘虜的具體數目各傳不一，宋、金兩方記載亦有互相矛盾之處，本篇不取確數。時間：順昌之戰在紹興十一年十月，金軍退屯柘皋與宋軍追至柘皋北面的決戰在同年十一月，隨即在十一月訂下《紹興和議》的正式條款。
dataEn: The number of figures that can be checked is not large, so only those that the histories record with some steadiness are given here. The Song garrison at Shun Chang: according to the biography of Liu Qi in the History of Song, Liu Qi had some eighteen thousand picked troops, in addition to the militia within the walls, equipped with strong crossbows and thunder-crash bombs. The size of the Jin invasion: the columns marched south by several routes and the total is recorded as more than one hundred thousand; the main Jin body at Shun Chang and on the Zhegao line is commonly called a hundred thousand, though the books differ and the various accounts are held side by side rather than reconciled. The Song force in the pursuit: Zhang Jun marched north from Si Zhou with his army, joined Liu Qi and the armies of the Huai, and is likewise recorded at a total of more than one hundred thousand. The length of the siege: Shun Chang was invested for rather more than a month, throughout which the Jin failed to carry the walls. The range and rate of fire of the crossbow: according to the treatise on weapons in the History of Song, the effective range of the divine-arm bow was about 240 paces, and the largest crossbows needed two or three men to draw them and were slow to reload, so that after a single salvo the crews had to fall back behind cover and re-string; the burst of the crossbow could therefore only be used in a fire-and-pause rhythm. Casualties and captures: the Song took heavy spoil at Zhegao, but the exact numbers of heads and prisoners are given differently in the various sources and the Song and Jin records even contradict one another, so no precise figure is taken here. The timing: the battle of Shun Chang fell in the tenth month of the eleventh year of Shaoxing, the Jin retreat to Zhegao and the Song pursuit to the north of Zhegao came in the eleventh month of the same year, and the formal articles of the Shaoxing peace settlement were concluded within that month.
cause: 這場戰爭直接由《紹興和議》的後續糾紛引發。紹興十一年正月，南宋與金朝達成和議：宋稱臣、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬兩匹，割唐、鄧二州及商、秦二州之半，換取金歸還河南、陝西，劃淮水至大散關為界，條件對南宋極為苛刻。和議生效之後，金熙宗完顏亶仍嫌所得太少，認為河南原是金土，趙家不該久據，遂派使到宋廷索取河南、陳西之地，措辭峻厲。高宗不許，遣使回絕，並命淮南各處整軍備禦。金人於是以此為口實再啟兵端，十月分道南下，主力直撲順昌。內部則是主戰與主和的拉鋸：秦檜、湯思退一意議和，張俊、劉錡等邊將則要趁金人新敗之餘收復淮南要地。順昌守住了，柘皋再敗金軍主力的念頭因此被推到前線，柘皋之戰才會在同年十一月爆發。
causeEn: This war was triggered directly by the aftermath of the Shaoxing peace settlement. In the first month of the eleventh year of the Shaoxing era the Southern Song and the Jin concluded a treaty: the Song would use the subordinate style, pay tribute in silver and silk of 250,000 units each, and cede Tang and Deng prefectures and half of Shang and Qin prefectures, in exchange for the Jin returning Henan and Shaanxi and for the frontier being fixed along the Huai River and up to Dasan Pass; the terms were extremely harsh for the Song. Once the settlement took effect the Jin emperor Wanyan Dan still found it insufficient, holding that Henan had always been Jin soil and that the Zhao house had no right to hold it for long, and he sent envoys to the Song court to demand Henan and the lands of Chuan and Xi in terms that were deliberately harsh. The emperor refused, sent envoys back to decline, and ordered the Huai garrisons to make ready. The Jin then used this as the pretext for a new war, marching south by several routes in the tenth month with the main effort on Shun Chang. Within the Song there was the running struggle between those who would fight and those who would negotiate: Qin Hui and Tang Si-tui were set on making peace, while frontier commanders such as Zhang Jun and Liu Qi wanted to seize the moment after the enemy's fresh defeat and recover the strategic towns of the Huai. Shun Chang held, and the plan to break the Jin main force once more at Zhegao was pushed to the front line, which is why the battle of Zhegao was fought in the eleventh month of that same year.
impact: 柘皋的結果，直接決定了《紹興和議》能不能落實。兩戰之後金人退回淮北，河南仍歸南宋，界線維持淮水至大散關，宋廷也沒有再作大規模反攻。南宋因此取得二十來年的相對安寧，直到隆興年間虞允文采石之戰才再破例，這段歲月讓江南的經濟與人口得以恢復，也讓張俊等主和派在朝中站穩，宋金之間的使節往來與榷場貿易重新運作。對金朝而言，這是一記悶棍：南侵不但沒有取回河南，完顏宗弼反而在柘皋折了兵馬，翌年即病逝，進取之志受挫，熙宗朝原本想再南下的氣勢為之一挫。從軍械角度看，順昌與柘皋兩役證明了弩與火藥爆彈在守城與野戰中的價值：弩手在城頭以機械拉力換取破甲力，火藥炸彈以聲光擾亂密集隊形，宋軍弓弩院與各軍的製弩作坊由此更受重視，弩與火藥搭配的戰法後來在南方山水林間的攻防戰裡沿用多年，也成了後世談宋軍器械時最常援引的實例。
impactEn: The result at Zhegao decided directly whether the Shaoxing settlement could be carried out. After the two engagements the Jin withdrew north of the Huai, Henan remained with the Song, the frontier stayed fixed along the Huai and up to Dasan Pass, and the Song court did not attempt a large-scale counter-offensive in return. The Song thus gained some twenty years of relative peace, broken only by Yu Yun-wen's battle of Caishi in the Longxing era, and those years allowed the economy and population of the south to recover and gave the peacemakers headed by Zhang Jun a firm position at court, while envoys and border trade between the two states resumed. For the Jin it was a blow: the invasion had not recovered Henan, Wanyan Zongbi had lost men and horses at Zhegao, and he died of illness the following year; the will to advance was checked and the momentum for a further southern push under Wanyan Dan was blunted. From the point of view of weapons, the two battles of Shun Chang and Zhegao demonstrated the value of the crossbow and of the gunpowder bomb in both defence and open battle: the crossbowman on the wall exchanged the slow rhythm of a bowman for mechanical force and armour-piercing power, and the gunpowder bomb disordered the crowded ranks with noise and flame. The Workshop of Bows and Crossbows and the crossbow workshops of the armies were consequently given greater weight, and the pairing of crossbow with gunpowder went on being used for many years afterwards in the fighting among the hills and forests of the south, becoming one of the most frequently cited practical examples in later discussions of Song military equipment.
result: 結果是宋軍的大勝。順昌之後，金軍退屯柘皋，張俊率大軍追及，在柘皋北面列陣交鋒：宋軍以弩箭齊射在前、火藥炸彈與火箭在中、步騎合擊在後，金軍前陣受炸即散，完顏宗弼僅以數十騎突圍北走，餘眾退保柘皋寨中，隨後焚寨北撤，宋軍追到淮水，收繳其輜重、馬匹甚多，斬獲甚眾。兩戰合計，金人自河南南下的主力在淮南碰了硬釘，渡淮深入之望就此斷絕；十一月，宋金在淮水一線重訂和議條款，宋仍割唐、鄧二州，歲貢銀絹各二十五萬兩匹，換取金歸還河南、陝西並罷兵，雙方劃界而治，宋廷由此把主要精力轉回內政，淮南防線成為此後二十年的固定邊界；金人此後亦不再以大軍深入淮南，柘皋遂成南宋軍史中最常被提起的守禦與野戰兼備的戰例之一。
resultEn: The outcome was a great Song victory. After Shun Chang the Jin withdrew to Zhegao; Zhang Jun led the main army in pursuit and engaged them on the north side of Zhegao. The Song order was crossbow volleys in front, gunpowder bombs and fire-arrows in the middle, and an advance of foot and horse together behind; the Jin front scattered as soon as the bombs went off among them, Wanyan Zongbi broke out to the north with only a few tens of horsemen, and the rest fell back into the camp at Zhegao, which they then burned before withdrawing north. The Song pursued as far as the Huai, taking much baggage and horses and cutting up the enemy in great numbers. Taken together the two battles meant that the main body of the Jin army from Henan had struck a hard wall in the Huai valley and the hope of pushing deep across the river was extinguished. In the eleventh month the Song and the Jin revised the terms of the peace along the Huai: the Song still ceded Tang and Deng and still paid tribute in silver and silk of 250,000 units each, in exchange for the Jin returning Henan and Shaanxi and standing the armies down, the two states thereafter governing within a fixed line. The Song court turned its main energy back to internal affairs, and the Huai River defence line became the settled frontier of the following twenty years. The Jin no longer drove a great army deep into the Huai valley, and Zhegao remained one of the most frequently cited battles in Southern Song military history, a case in which defence and open-field action were joined in the same campaign.
